mapper.select: select c.chunk_id, c.doc_id, c.chunk_index, c.content, c.keywords, c.embedding, c.create_time from mall_knowledge_chunk c inner join mall_knowledge_doc d on d.doc_id = c.doc_id and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '1' order by c.doc_id, c.chunk_index
mapper.insert: insert into mall_knowledge_chunk (doc_id, chunk_index, content, keywords, embedding, create_time) values (#{docId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{content}, #{keywords}, #{embedding}, sysdate())
